cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(tests-live)

# Local checkout option, as in ../tests. The rest is generated by trusscli.
set(TRUSSC_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "TrussC checkout (contains core/ and addons/)")
if(TRUSSC_ROOT)
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/standalone.cmake")
    return()
endif()

# TRUSSC_DIR is provided by CMakePresets.json (generated by trusscli)
# For CI/manual builds without presets, fallback to relative path
if(NOT DEFINED TRUSSC_DIR)
    set(TRUSSC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../core")
endif()

include(${TRUSSC_DIR}/cmake/trussc_app.cmake)

trussc_app()
